g.text: 1 µF 25 V at IN and OUT

g.desc: 1 µF 25 V at IN and OUT

g.style: fill:none; stroke:none;

g.text: 1. Function: the HAT port's VBUS under USB PD (hats standard/ interface v2, RFC 0014): eFuse #A

g.desc: 1. Function: the HAT port's VBUS under USB PD (hats standard/ interface v2, RFC 0014): eFuse #A

g.text: sources 5 V (TCPM vbus-supply on HAT5V_EN), the TPS2121 IN2 sinks 5 V from a source HAT.

g.desc: sources 5 V (TCPM vbus-supply on HAT5V_EN), the TPS2121 IN2 sinks 5 V from a source HAT.

g.text: 2. Absent state: HAT5V_EN low, VBUS discharged; the FUSB302B01 presents Rd on CC, also

g.desc: 2. Absent state: HAT5V_EN low, VBUS discharged; the FUSB302B01 presents Rd on CC, also

g.text: unpowered (dead-battery support), so a source HAT can feed the T1.

g.desc: unpowered (dead-battery support), so a source HAT can feed the T1.

g.text: 3. One CC (the pogo field is keyed): CC2 open; VCONN not sourced, open (UNVERIFIED termination).

g.desc: 3. One CC (the pogo field is keyed): CC2 open; VCONN not sourced, open (UNVERIFIED termination).

g.text: 4. Discharge: DMG1012T with 100 Ω (50 mA at 5 V), gate on HAT_VBUS_DISCH after the source is off;

g.desc: 4. Discharge: DMG1012T with 100 Ω (50 mA at 5 V), gate on HAT_VBUS_DISCH after the source is off;

g.text: the value against the PD discharge time and the port capacitance is UNVERIFIED (§7 item 47).

g.desc: the value against the PD discharge time and the port capacitance is UNVERIFIED (§7 item 47).

g.text: 5. The VBUS TVS and the ESD arrays sit on the device-side piece at the pogo field (BOM lines 65, 68, 69).

g.desc: 5. The VBUS TVS and the ESD arrays sit on the device-side piece at the pogo field (BOM lines 65, 68, 69).

g.text: eFuse #A, HAT VBUS source, RILM 1.87 kΩ (line 44)

g.desc: eFuse #A, HAT VBUS source, RILM 1.87 kΩ (line 44)
